purpose: Structured machine-native surface over the same AXM host core used by human interfaces.

load.effect: Replaces current cartridge session manifest and resets cartridge permission decisions.

snapshot.output: Current host snapshot including cartridge, capability counts, permissions, preferences and evidence.

permission.effect: Changes current session permission decision only.

propose_action.output: Action receipt. Current foundation always reports execution=not_executed until a verified runtime adapter exists.

invariants: Machine and human surfaces normalize through the same shared host core.
Action proposals are not represented as executed work.
Presentation preferences do not rewrite source evidence.
Truth, Agency/non-domination, Continuity and Wisdom before speed remain the internal constitutional gate.
